market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI trades around $103 with recent highs of $109. Hitting $110 (only ~7% from spot, basically at recent peak) in May with Hormuz disruption ongoing is highly likely — even modest escalation or supply news prints there. Probability ~75-82%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: A sudden Hormuz resolution that dumps oil back to mid-$80s before any May 1m candle prints $110.
